name: Awakewood
source:
Will returns to Awakewood to bury his mother and sell the family home before the next bus arrives. Instead, he finds an isolated town under endless rain and a forest creeping over the edge of the property.

The night before leaving, Will finds a girl with no memory tangled in roots and mud. Choosing to shelter her until the road clears, he shuts himself inside a house that is decaying from within, as memories he thought he had buried begin to surface.

In this first-person psychological horror visual novel, the story unfolds through Will’s eyes: a quiet, matter-of-fact internal voice clashing against the physical breakdown of a house that warps by the hour. Every choice nudges the stranger toward human connection or total surrender to the woods, in a domestic mystery where no decision is free and there are no easy escapes.

Awakewood is a standalone, intimate horror story about grief, guilt, and the cost of refusing to be alone.

A house that offers no shelter
Rain beats down on the roof and mud stains the outer walls. Inside, the floorboards creak underfoot, the air smells of old damp, and the stain on the ceiling grows wider every night. The house does not keep the outside away: it rots alongside everyone inside it.

The dread of living together
It all begins in the daily routine: sitting down to eat with a stranger pulled from the mud, noticing she never feels cold, and dealing with her strange behavior as she does whatever it takes to keep you from leaving her behind.

The town clock
The bus passes every Thursday at 7:10 AM. It is the only way out. But with each passing night, stepping through that front door gets harder—and by the time the next bus arrives, the house will not be the same.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4320140]Steam[/url]]
translation:
威尔回到醒木镇安葬母亲，并打算在下一班公交车到来前卖掉老宅。然而映入他眼帘的，却是笼罩在无尽阴雨中的孤立小镇，以及正悄然越过宅邸边界、步步蚕食而来的森林。

临行前夜，威尔在盘根错节的树根与泥泞中发现了一名失去记忆的少女。他决定收留她到道路放行，于是将自己关进了这栋正从内部腐朽崩坏的老屋里，而那些他以为早已埋葬的记忆也开始悄然浮出水面。

在这部第一人称心理恐怖视觉小说中，故事将透过威尔的视角徐徐展开：冷静平实的内心独白，与每时每刻都在扭曲变形的房屋实体形成了强烈碰撞。在这场没有任何决定无需付出代价、也不存在轻松退路的居家悬疑剧里，你的每一次抉择都会将这名陌路少女推向人性的羁绊，或是彻底向森林臣服。

《醒木镇》是一部独立成篇的私密恐怖物语，探讨悲痛、罪恶感，以及拒绝孤独所必须付出的代价。

无处庇护的老宅
雨水猛烈敲打着屋顶，泥浆斑驳了外墙。屋内，脚下的木地板吱呀作响，空气中弥漫着陈年潮气，天花板上的污渍每过一夜便扩大一分。这栋房子并不会将外界隔绝在外——它正与屋里的每一个人一同腐烂。

同居日常中的寒意
一切都始于寻常的起居日常：与从泥泞中救起的陌生少女同桌用餐，察觉她从不觉得寒冷，并应对她那古怪异常的举止——为了阻止你丢下她离开，她将不惜一切代价。

小镇的时刻表
公交车每周四早上7:10途经此地，那是离开这里的唯一途径。然而每过一夜，迈出那扇前门就变得愈发艰难——等到下一班公交车抵达时，这栋宅子早已不再是原来的模样。
